checkpoints.code: unsigned int klass = buffer->idx < buffer->len ? machine.get_class (info[buffer->idx].codepoint, num_glyphs) : (unsigned) StateTable<EntryData>::CLASS_END_OF_TEXT; const Entry<EntryData> *entry = machine.get_entryZ (state, klass);
checkpoints.note: First project statement on the witnessed vulnerable path that materializes attacker-controlled `morx` state. On the crashing iteration `buffer->idx == buffer->len`, so the driver selects `CLASS_END_OF_TEXT` and fetches the corresponding insertion entry whose flags and indices drive the copy-after-current path.

Root cause. The current-insert path treats `!before` as sufficient to copy a current glyph, but on the end-of-text entry there is no live current glyph. The vulnerable code omits the required `buffer->idx < buffer->len` guard before `copy_glyph()` and the matching `skip_glyph()` call, so it copies `info[len]` from uninitialized tail storage.
